Docs.summary: Provides interfaces and classes for reading and updating file and file-system attributes.

remarks.para: Attribute views expose named sets of file metadata. Basic, POSIX, DOS, ACL, owner, user-defined, and file-store views support the attribute models available from a file system.

format.a: Java documentation for the java.nio.file.attribute package.
